answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the willow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sparrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
